class.name: HTMLDocumentFragment
class.brief_description: A detached collection of HTML elements for batch insertion.
class.description: Create a fragment with [method HTMLLayout.create_document_fragment] or [method HTMLLabel.create_document_fragment]. Add elements from the same layout with [method append_child]. Insert them through [method HTMLElement.append_fragment] or [method HTMLElement.insert_fragment_before]. A successful insertion preserves the element handles and empties the fragment for reuse. Direct children are detached from the document and return [code]null[/code] from [method HTMLElement.get_parent] while in the fragment. Clearing or reparsing the layout invalidates the fragment and the handles it still holds.

method.name: append_child
method.description: Moves [param child] to the end of the fragment. If the child was connected, its removal schedules a document update. Returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for an invalid fragment or child, a child from a different layout, or the document root.

method.name: clone_node
method.description: Returns a new detached fragment in the same layout. A deep copy includes all content in order, including text and comments from a template. A shallow copy is empty. Returns [code]null[/code] if this fragment is invalid.

method.name: get_children
method.description: Returns a snapshot of the direct children in order, or an empty array if the fragment is invalid.

method.name: get_element_by_id
method.description: Returns the first element in tree order with the given case-sensitive HTML ID. Supply the raw ID without [code]#[/code]. Returns [code]null[/code] if the ID is absent, the ID is empty, or the fragment is invalid. Nested template contents are searched through their own fragments.

method.name: query_selector
method.description: Returns the first matching element in tree order, or [code]null[/code] when nothing matches or the fragment is invalid. See [method query_selector_all] for selector scope and syntax.

method.name: query_selector_all
method.description: Returns a snapshot of matching elements in tree order, with each element included once. [code]:scope > .row[/code] selects direct children with the [code]row[/code] class. A query for [code]:scope[/code] alone returns an empty array because the fragment root has no element handle. A nested template can match as an element. Query its [member HTMLTemplateElement.content] separately to find its contents. Invalid or unsupported selectors report a Godot error. An invalid fragment or a selector with no matches returns an empty array. See [method HTMLLayout.query_selector_all] for supported syntax.

method.name: get_first_element_child
method.description: Returns the first direct element child, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_last_element_child
method.description: Returns the last direct element child, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_child_element_count
method.description: Returns the number of direct element children.

method.name: replace_children
method.description: Replaces the child nodes with the given nodes, plain strings, and fragments. Removed nodes retain their handles.

method.name: insert_before
method.description: Moves a node or fragment before the reference child, or appends it if the reference is [code]null[/code].

method.name: remove_child
method.description: Detaches a direct child and retains its handle.

method.name: replace_child
method.description: Replaces a direct child and retains the outgoing handle.
